notes: Both asher li clauses are compressed into a single English possessive: the suffix takes my, the relative and the possessive preposition are unrepresented, and the noun's article keeps nothing since another morpheme licenses the determiner (rules 40, 41, the latter's sentence on a licensing morpheme outside the noun phrase).
ad im is fused as one until (rule 30); the competing reading would give until to ad and mark im unrepresented.
